<ul class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;">ITR-1 and ITR-4 can now be used by individuals with LTCG up to ₹1.25 lakh.</p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;">Aadhaar Enrolment ID is no longer accepted — only Aadhaar number.</p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;">ITR-4 now asks for declaration if you're opting out of the new regime.</p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;">More clarity in reporting exempt income and income from foreign sources.</p>
</li>
</ul>
